rendered: Per Fig. 8[1], the NMP-processed slurry (PVDF binder) is at 45[2]wt% solids[3] solids, while the water-based slurry (PVDF latex plus CMC binder) is at 65[4]wt% solids[5]. Replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC therefore raises the solids content by 20[6] percentage points. This is the difference between the solids levels stated in the figure caption, not a separately measured change.
